description: Golden values for the focus timer's rules (#765): the goal and countdown text, the wall-clock countdown, what an end saves, the goal step after a completed save, and the picker's categories. Web src/lib/focusActivity.ts (formatFocusGoal, formatFocusCountdown, focusCountdownFontSize, focusRemainingSeconds, resolveFocusEnd, focusActivityDayAfterCompletedSave) + src/lib/focusActivityContent.ts (FOCUS_ACTIVITIES) and iOS StillPointShared FocusActivityLogic.swift (FocusActivity.formatGoal, countdownDisplay, countdownShowsHours, remainingSeconds, resolveEnd, focusActivityDayAfterCompletedSave, FocusCategory.pickerDescription) + Constants.swift (FocusCategory.displayLabel) duplicate this on purpose (#840). Times are milliseconds after the session started.

remainingSeconds.name: a part second shows the full goal
a whole second takes one off
zero exactly when the goal has elapsed
stays at zero past the goal
a clock that moved backwards shows the full goal

resolveEnd.name: a countdown that ran out is completed at the goal
expiry noticed late still saves the goal, not the overrun
End early saves the whole seconds spent, not completed
End before a whole second has passed saves nothing
End at one second is a real, ended-early session
End one second short of the goal is still ended early
End at the goal counts as reaching it
End after the goal counts as reaching it, capped at the goal
the two-hour cap ended at its midpoint

focusActivityDayAfterCompletedSave.name: steps the counter by one, the server's rule
steps a later counter by one
a re-read that already applied the step is not stepped again
keeps stepping past the goal cap
